first.rationale: I currently intend to simplify onboarding because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates onboarding improvements increase adoption and time-to-value without sacrificing long-term value. I will verify the onboarding result and compare it with the archived promotional-pricing evidence before committing, since pricing may address competitor pressure but could weaken sustainable revenue. The test should use qualified activation, retention, and revenue guardrails rather than completion alone.
